method: Direct inspection of native-resolution PNGs for all six target platforms.
findings: The digital clock and its plaque are absent on rectangular and round screens.
The original fish, kelp, castle, bubbles, gravel and glass-frame composition is preserved.
The noon school and minute-counting plants and nuggets remain visible in color and monochrome.
limits: Emulator visual review. Physical-watch readability and battery use remain unmeasured.
